_comment: Per-source freshness map used by DataFreshnessIndicator. Matches doc 07 §26 DataStatus schema. v3 (2026-06-26): refreshed against the 2026-06-19 confirmed Friday close + May 2026 monthly releases. Two changes vs v2 (2026-05-29): (i) in-repo BTC monthlies now carry the confirmed May 31 close, so the source flips DELAYED→FRESH (no newer confirmed monthly candle exists until June 30); (ii) CoinGlass:ETF flips DELAYED→UNAVAILABLE — its spot-ETF data routes now 404 (page structure changed) and the canonical Farside cross-check stays Cloudflare-blocked, so ETF-01 is scored UNAVAILABLE per doc 02 §10.1 this cycle. Yahoo:GC=F remains a SUBSTITUTE for the retired FRED LBMA gold series (methodology drift D-gold-2026-05-29). This file and apps/web/data/market/regime.json#data_status MUST list the same source set (audit gate).

sources.message: BTC monthly price series spliced (CoinMetrics 2010-07 → 2014-08; Yahoo 2014-09 onwards). Authoritative for BTC structural signals (BTC-01..04); June 2026 monthly candle appended 2026-07-11 (Yahoo close $58,558.86, cross-verified against CoinGecko $58,557.70 at the July 1 UTC boundary). Last confirmed monthly close June 30, 2026 per doc 02 §5.1. Next update due at July 31 monthly close.

Trade-weighted broad-dollar index used per doc 02 §9 (DXY proxy; license-free alternative to ICE DXY). Series published through July 2 at refresh time (July 3 was a US holiday; ~1-week publication lag) — the strict-Friday convention therefore anchors MAC-01 at the June 26 weekly close this cycle.
Monthly liquidity series; the May 2026 reading (released late June) is the latest available release. Next monthly release expected late July (typical FRED M2SL cadence).

Methodology drift D-gold-2026-05-29: spec primary FRED GOLDAMGBD228NLBM (LBMA AM fix) and GOLDPMGBD228NLBM (LBMA PM fix) both returned 404 — FRED retired the LBMA series. Yahoo GC=F (front-month gold futures) substituted; fetched live this cycle. Result direction for REL-01 (ratio-vs-EMA-of-self) is robust to the substitute. Replacement canonical source tracked in PENDING_ALL.md 5.29.

ETF net-flows could not be observed this cycle (2026-07-11). The CoinGlass spot-ETF routes still return HTTP 404 (route structure changed 2026-06; homepage loads, so routing change, not a block). The spec-canonical Farside manual feed remains behind a Cloudflare challenge wall (policy forbids evasion per doc 02 §8.3 + doc 06 §6.5); SoSoValue also Cloudflare-blocked. With fewer than the required trailing-four confirmed weekly aggregates observable, ETF-01 is evaluated UNAVAILABLE per §10.1 and contributes 0 of 2 points (score-invariant: an INACTIVE read would also award 0). Canonical Farside acquisition tracked in PENDING_ALL.md 5.28.
